title: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila
abstract: arXiv:2610.34638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Animals have a remarkable capacity for autonomy---driven by intrinsic motivation---without external sensory cues or extrinsic objectives, yet the computational mechanisms behind this ability largely remain a mystery. We combine whole-brain recordings in the fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster), which reveal neural representations of spontaneous exploratory decisions more than 10 seconds in advance, with a neuromechanical digital twin to test whether optimizing intrinsic goals yields realistically embodied artificial agents that quantitatively match fly behavior and internal representations of future volitional action during exploration. Our hierarchical policy selects from a discrete library of low-level motor primitives, consistent with ethological theories of behavioral syllables. translated_title: 自主智能体的内在目标：分层探索捕捉果蝇未来的自主意志行为
translated_abstract: 动物拥有卓越的自主能力——由内在动机驱动——无需外部感觉线索或外在目标即可行动，然而这种能力背后的计算机制在很大程度上仍是一个谜。我们结合果蝇（黑腹果蝇）的全脑记录（这些记录揭示了自发性探索决策提前10秒以上的神经表征）与神经力学数字孪生技术，以检验优化内在目标是否能产生在定量上匹配果蝇行为以及探索过程中未来自主意志行动内部表征的、具有真实身体形态的人工智能体。我们的分层策略从离散的低级运动基元库中进行选择，这与行为音节（behavioral syllables）的行为学理论一致。我们使用涵盖好奇心、熵和胜任力方法的20种内在动机算法，在没有外部奖励的情况下训练这些智能体。这些智能体的评估……
tldr: 该研究将果蝇全脑记录与神经力学数字孪生相结合，证明了使用20种内在动机算法训练的分层自主智能体能够在定量层面再现果蝇的自发探索行为及其对未来自主意志行动的神经表征。
en_tdlr: By combining whole-brain Drosophila recordings with a neuromechanical digital twin, this study demonstrates that hierarchical agents trained with 20 intrinsic motivation algorithms quantitatively reproduce fly spontaneous exploratory behavior and neural representations of future volitional action.
